name: a better schlo dating simulation
source: Help Oran get a boyfriend in a short, fun dating sim that doesn't even need a trigger warning! (There is slight mention of "adult" things, but nothing too dark!) With 12 different endings, the game should be a good hour worth of fun!
translation: 帮助奥兰在一款短小有趣、甚至不需要触发警告的恋爱模拟游戏中找到男朋友！（游戏只会略微提到“成人”内容，没有任何黑暗情节！）共有12种不同结局，足够带来大约一小时的乐趣！
